description: SkillOpt 风格精化 6 步流水线：压缩 skill、切分训练集、准备候选场景稿、训练与验证、提升最佳 skill、回灌验证。
_pipeline_status: 主代理按 plan steps 运行确定性脚本；optimizer 使用 active gen-model profile。
_skillopt_paper: arXiv:2605.23904 + microsoft/SkillOpt · 论文超参 epoch=4 rollout=40 minibatch=8 L_t=4→2

steps.name: preflight-compact
steps.description: 前置:验证 skill_FINAL.md/cluster_index.json 存在 + 切 SLOW/FAST/REFERENCE 三段(skill_compactor)。
scripts: python -c "import sys, pathlib; p=pathlib.Path('{project_root}'); assert (p/'skill_FINAL.md').exists(), 'skill_FINAL.md 缺失,先跑 /distill-style'; assert (p/'cluster_index.json').exists(), 'cluster_index.json 缺失'"

steps.name: dataset-split
steps.description: 确定性切分 train/select/test = 60/20/20 (论文 SearchQA 范式)。同 seed 重跑稳定。

steps.name: prepare-claude-scene-jobs
steps.description: 以固定 run_id 固化训练 schedule/checkpoint，并登记首批候选场景任务。主代理必须按 manifest 逐项 spawn novel-replica-writer；每项只消费自身 candidate skill，场景稿和 agent_report 均不可跨 digest 复用。

steps.name: train-loop
steps.description: 主训练循环 epoch=4。每个 rollout 只消费 manifest 中与候选 digest 唯一绑定的 Claude 场景稿；动态候选缺稿时 exit 2，补稿后用同一 run_id 恢复。validation gate 严格优于才升级。

steps.name: promote-best-skill
steps.description: 把 train 产出的 best_skill.md 合并 SLOW 段提升为新 skill_FINAL.md (备份旧版到 skill_FINAL.md.bak)。
scripts: python -c "import shutil, pathlib; p=pathlib.Path('{project_root}'); shutil.copy(p/'skill_FINAL.md', p/'skill_FINAL.md.bak')"

python -c "import pathlib; p=pathlib.Path('{project_root}'); best=p/'_skillopt/train/skillopt-main/best_skill.md'; assert best.exists(), 'best_skill.md 缺失'; (p/'skill_FINAL.md').write_text(best.read_text(encoding='utf-8'), encoding='utf-8'); print(f'[OK] promoted {best} → skill_FINAL.md')"

steps.name: writer-feedback-verify
steps.description: 最终同栈回灌：Claude 按 skill_FINAL 写 required 场景稿，distill_finalize_verify 用 gemini 润色并产结构报告；distill_av_verify 对同一复刻产 AV 报告。两次执行和两份报告都 required，AV 判别本身保持 advisory。
scripts: python core/scripts/distill_finalize_verify.py --project {project_root} --skill {project_root}/skill_FINAL.md --cluster-id <first_cluster_id> --claude-scenes-dir {project_root}/复刻测试/writer_feedback_verify/claude_scenes --output {project_root}/对比报告/skillopt_verify.json

python core/scripts/distill_av_verify.py --project {project_root} --cluster-id <first_cluster_id> --replica {project_root}/复刻测试/writer_feedback_verify/<first_cluster_id>_replica.txt --output {project_root}/对比报告/skillopt_av_verify.json

_north_star_alignment: ①更贴近作者风格 ②每 rollout 以 cluster 为单位 ③reward 来自真实写作链路 ④章节只作输出格式 ⑤只读现有 binary 信号且不新增 hard_gate ⑥SkillOpt 是唯一风格 skill 训练入口
